findings.title: CoinJoin / mixing transaction
findings.detail: 5 equal outputs of 2 BTC (5 inputs -> 6 outputs). Output links to inputs are deliberately ambiguous; downstream attribution confidence is reduced.

findings.title: Peel chain of 4 hops
findings.detail: Large balance repeatedly split into a small 'peel' payment and a large change output; 0.96 BTC peeled in total. Peel endpoints: no labeled endpoints.

findings.title: 3 rapid pass-through address(es)
findings.detail: Addresses that forwarded >=90% of received funds within 60 minutes - typical of layering / relay wallets.

findings.title: Address cluster #1 (2 addresses)
findings.detail: Addresses spent together as inputs of one transaction (common-input-ownership). Cluster inherits label: DemoLocker ransom wallet #1 [ransomware].
